node.statement: By lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope, the three relevant target projections P_R, P_U, and P_V are c0*epsilon-projections, so their projection defects are bounded by c0*epsilon; A_R is an extended L^0*epsilon-C*-algebra; and the subordination and complementarity errors for U,V inside R are bounded by L^0*epsilon.
node.author: pf-1_3_1-r1
